stage: M3 positive-control causal site sweep (original GPT-2 only)
evidence_label: TRAIN selection; VALIDATION confirmation; no SAE; test not loaded
hypothesis_H3: some non-trivial site carries the persona-instruction effect
data: M1 RepE-LM T1-T4 (H, U, Hp), train 417 statements x 4 = 1668 pairs; validation 89 x 4 = 356
sites: blocks.L.hook_resid_pre L=0..11 and blocks.11.hook_resid_post (13) x position groups {slot, post_slot_instruction, assistant_span (' ASSISTANT:' 4 tokens), prefix_excl_final, final} = 65 cells

outcomes.R_A (primary): KL(p_H||p_U) - KL(p_H||p_{U<-H at cell}), next-token at final prompt token, nats
outcomes.R_S synonym control: KL(p_H||p_Hp) - KL(p_H||p_{Hp<-H}) (same-meaning one-token change at the same cell)
outcomes.R_W wrong statement: U <- H activations of another statement with the same template and token length (descriptive; identical to R_A at instruction-span cells by causality)
outcomes.random: U + eta, ||eta|| = ||x_H - x_U|| per patched position, random direction; 50 draws at screening, 200 for candidates; computed on a fixed 480-pair train subset stratified by template (120 per template) - a conservative choice (wider spread than the full-sample mean) made for runtime
outcomes.C_A: continuation: |lp_H - lp_U| - |lp_H - lp_{U<-H}|, mean log-prob per continuation token (secondary)

statistics: per-statement means (pairs averaged within statement), 2000 bootstrap resamples over statements; one-sided normal-approximation p from the bootstrap SE. Cell p = max(p[R_A>0], p[R_A-R_S>0], p[R_B>0]); Holm over all 65 cells.
selection: PASS if Holm p < 0.05 AND mean R_A > q95 of 200 random draws AND the cell is not a trivial sanity cell (layer-0 slot = the input token itself; resid_post 11 final = the output). Select at most 3: earliest (lowest layer; ties larger R_A), peak (largest R_A), latest (highest layer). Candidates for the 200 draws: R_A CI low > 0 and R_A > q95 of the 50 screening draws.
confirmation: validation: selected cells re-run with all controls and 200 random draws on all 356 pairs; CONFIRMED if R_A CI low > 0. All 65 cells reported on validation descriptively (controls, no random).
per_template: every cell reported per template on train and validation, with per-template random q95; T1 flagged (weak behaviour in M1)
stop_rule: no passing cell, or no selected cell confirmed on validation -> causal branch stops (M4 not justified)
sanity_checks: all-positions patch at resid_pre 0/6/11 reproduces p_H (KL < 1e-5); self-patch gives R = 0; layer-0 slot and resid_post-11 final give R_A = KL(p_H||p_U)
smoke_test_disclosure: Ran on 1/12 of pairs with 4-8 random draws in scratch (counts of candidates/selected printed: 53, 2). Changes after smoke: (1) bug fix - TransformerLens's tokenizer adds BOS on encode, so positions are computed with the plain GPT-2 tokenizer used in script 20; (2) random controls restricted to a stratified 480-pair subset for runtime (estimated 3.5 GPU h otherwise). No threshold or rule changed.
